summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting periodic share repurchases executed under the second tranche of its €3.5 billion multi-year buyback program, with average prices and consideration aggregated daily for Euronext Milan and NYSE transactions through June 19, 2026. No tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or special transaction is announced; the filing is an ordinary buyback update mandated by foreign private issuer reporting. The company holds 9.57% of issued capital in treasury, with share cancellation approved but not yet effectuated. This is routine disclosure, not a special situation.
